questions.q: She ___ to the library yesterday.
questions.e: Yesterday indique le passé : on dit went.

questions.q: We ___ our homework already.
questions.e: Already peut accompagner have + participe passé.

questions.q: If it rains, we ___ at home.
questions.e: Pour une possibilité future, on dit If + présent, puis will.

questions.q: This road is ___ than the old one.
questions.e: Avec un adjectif court, on ajoute -er pour comparer.

questions.q: You ___ wear a helmet when riding a motorbike.
questions.e: Should sert à donner un conseil.

questions.q: The test was ___ than the one we did last week.
questions.e: Avec un adjectif court comme easy, on ajoute -er pour comparer.

questions.q: How ___ students are in your class?
questions.e: Many accompagne un nom que l’on peut compter : students.

questions.q: He has lived in Dakar ___ 2022.
questions.e: Since indique le début d’une durée.

questions.q: They have waited ___ two hours.
questions.e: For indique une durée.

questions.q: My sister is interested ___ science.
questions.e: On dit be interested in something.

questions.q: The children ___ football when the bell rang.
questions.e: Were playing décrit une action en cours dans le passé.

questions.q: I ___ call you when I arrive.
questions.e: Will exprime ici une action future.

questions.q: This is the ___ book in the series.
questions.e: Most interesting est le superlatif de cet adjectif long.

questions.q: You ___ smoke inside the hospital.
questions.e: Mustn’t exprime une interdiction.

questions.q: We ___ bring food; the school will provide lunch.
questions.e: Don’t have to veut dire que ce n’est pas nécessaire.

questions.q: There are ___ oranges in the basket, enough for everyone.
questions.e: A few accompagne un nom comptable au pluriel.

questions.q: The train is not as ___ as the bus.
questions.e: Après as, on garde l’adjectif à sa forme simple.

questions.q: She ___ her keys, so she cannot open the door.
questions.e: Has lost relie une action passée à la situation présente.

questions.q: While I ___ dinner, my brother washed the dishes.
questions.e: Was cooking décrit l’action en cours pendant l’autre action passée.

questions.q: You look tired. You ___ get some rest.
questions.e: Should donne un conseil.

questions.q: The letters ___ every Friday.
questions.e: Au passif, on utilise be + participe passé.

questions.q: I have never ___ a camel.
questions.e: Après have, on utilise le participe passé ridden.

questions.q: She speaks English ___ than she did last year.
questions.e: Better est le comparatif de well.

questions.q: We stayed inside ___ the weather was bad.
questions.e: Because introduit la cause.
